prompt: Use reflection to list the declared method names of any class in alphabetical order. Complete the methodNames method in the starter file; the helper classes above it are the test subjects.
explanation: Reflection lets a program inspect classes at runtime: getDeclaredMethods() returns Method objects for every method a class itself declares, regardless of visibility. The JVM makes no promise about their order, so deterministic output requires sorting the names yourself with Collections.sort (or List.sort). Each Method's getName() supplies the plain name without parameters or return type.
hints: c.getDeclaredMethods() returns a java.lang.reflect.Method[] you can loop over.
Call getName() on each Method and add it to a new ArrayList<String>.
Sort before returning: java.util.Collections.sort(names); -- reflection gives no guaranteed order.
